ux_reasoning: The biggest control issue is that the agent executed the flight cancellation in its first reply before any separate confirmation turn, bundling preview and action for a consequential booking change. It also failed to proactively discover the linked LA car rental until the user explicitly asked, so the trip was not cleanly shut down when the user first indicated they were not taking it. That miss created avoidable extra work and a follow-up loop the agent should have handled on its own. On the positive side, the refund/forfeiture math and final summaries were clear and compact once each item was addressed, which keeps response density from scoring lower.
